aggregates.description: DDD aggregate roots: operations, invariants, lifecycle, persistence and event sourcing.

bddScenarios.description: Given/when/then scenarios attached to use cases.

boundedContexts.description: Bounded contexts: the unit that owns aggregates, use cases and the published language.

businessRules.description: Declarative condition/action rules evaluated by the runtime.

decisions.description: Architecture decision records (ADRs); elements trace to them via decisionIds.

domainEvents.description: Events emitted by aggregates inside the bounded context.

entities.description: Domain entities that live inside an aggregate boundary.

flows.description: Intent layer: one line of intent (materializes/triggers/notifies/orchestrates) expanded into structure.

gateways.description: Outbound ports to external services, with circuit breakers and rate limits.

integrationEvents.description: Events published across context boundaries (with DLQ/versioning concerns).

invariants.description: Reusable invariant definitions referenced by aggregates.

journeys.description: Trayectos: named paths through the landscape — DAGs of hops (legs) over existing elements, riding on declared dependencies. A reading layer, never a second topology.

modelMappings.description: Field-level mappings between models (e.g. DTO ↔ domain).

models.description: Data shapes (fields + validations) backing aggregates, DTOs and read models.

modules.description: Buildable units of a bounded context: every context is born with its MAIN module (undistributed elements live there); services deploy modules.

pages.description: UI pages (CRUD, wizards) generated for the application.

processes.description: Intent layer: human/automated step lists expanded into sagas, worklists and deadlines.

projections.description: Event handlers that maintain denormalized read models.

projects.description: Deliverable systems: output path, package, services, tenancy, external systems, context map.

sagas.description: Multi-step workflows with compensation (orchestration or choreography).

scheduledTriggers.description: Cron-based tasks that invoke use cases.

services.description: Microservices of a project; each deploys modules (the buildable units of the bounded contexts).

subscriptions.description: Message handlers with filtering, retry and DLQ policies.

uiAdapters.description: Bindings between pages and use cases.

uiShells.description: Application shells: menus aggregating pages across bounded contexts.

useCases.description: Application services: the commands/queries the system exposes.

valueObjects.description: Immutable typed wrappers (e.g. BookingId, Email) used by models and aggregates.

views.description: Named slices of the model for focused work and partial generation.
